diagnosis.label: Generator loss increase
diagnosis.cause_hint: Generator losses ≈ 1.24× nominal (4.3 % of shaft power instead of 3.45 %).
diagnosis.advisory: The direct-drive generator converts more power into heat than the twin expects — typical of stator-winding insulation ageing or inter-turn faults, weakened magnets (more current for the same torque) or main-bearing distress. Compare the stator-winding PT100s phase by phase, measure insulation resistance and polarisation index, and review main-bearing temperature and vibration.

prognosis.limit_note: Illustrative end-of-life criterion: generator losses doubled (≈ +68 K stator winding at rated load in this model — beyond the class-F margin).
